title: TextEdit with line wrapping added at runtime has wrong scrollbar
body:
### Tested versions

4.5-beta4, 4.5-beta3, 4.4.1

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1235U (12 threads)

### Issue description

In my game, I'm adding a TextEdit at runtime, and if there are wrapped lines its scrollbar gets completely messed up. Here's a simple replication of this:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/136039b1-0213-4230-a048-da159a8a520f

As seen on the video above, the TextEdit scrollbar changes its size when you click inside or even if you click the window title.

### Steps to reproduce

Add a control, add a panel container and adjust it, and add a script on the control with the following method:

```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.05).timeout
	var text_edit := TextEdit.new()
	text_edit.wrap_mode = TextEdit.LINE_WRAPPING_BOUNDARY
	text_edit.text = """The city is filthy. The night sky pours down rain like it has a personal grudge. A mournful serenade to the lost souls that roam this city. But while rain comes from above, something else comes from below. A thick black sludge seeps up though the cracks in the streets, as if the city itself is bleeding its own filth and corruption. "It'll stick to yer sole", they laugh. But most people have long stopped wondering what exactly is coming from the depths of the streets. Just another bit of filth to scrape off at the end of the day."""
	$PanelContainer.add_child(text_edit)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[text-edit-scrollbar-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21561114/text-edit-scrollbar-bug.zip)
